experiment: S2-only input-information paired Plain MSE versus BSAM (MSE-FiLM, from scratch)
run_order: six arms launched in parallel on one GPU
early_stopping: stop when 5 consecutive full-Validation epoch-end checks produce no new lowest Overall RMSE, applicable from any epoch (no fixed minimum; amended 2026-11-10 from a 14-epoch minimum per user instruction); hard cap E28
amendment_note: 2026-11-10: E14 minimum removed before any arm completed; prior partial runs (max E7, no COMPLETE) archived under archived_min14_rule/; all six arms restarted from scratch under this protocol
test_evaluation_audit: 2026-11-10 21:25 first execution crashed in post-evaluation cleanup (AttributeError: 'OfficialTrainData' object has no attribute 'close') after all six per-arm Test metrics were computed and printed but before JSON/prediction files were written; cleanup-only bug fixed (no metric code touched); deterministic re-run at 21:38 completed and produced bit-identical per-arm metrics; single evaluation event, no Test information used in any selection decision
mask: after frozen preprocessing, immediately before the model forward pass: retain the 12 S2 bands; replace DEM patch, land-cover channels, normalized ALOS channels, original ALOS DN, and all 8 metadata values (incl. S2 date and coordinates) with fixed zero tensors; branches remain in the network; S2-only input-information experiment, not a reduced architecture; mask applied identically to both arms including both BSAM passes and Validation evaluation
model: MSE-FiLM, 2123367 parameters, same architecture as Review-12; trained from scratch
initialization: same deterministic random initialization as Review-12 per seed (paired initial tensor SHA-256 identical to Review-12 preflight); both arms within a seed share it
input: same official Train/Validation sample identities and frozen MSE-FiLM preprocessing for both arms
scheduler: StepLR(step_size=30, gamma=0.1), stepped once after each completed epoch
precision: BF16 autocast forward, FP32 losses and optimizer
plain: unweighted center-pixel MSE, one forward/backward per update
bsam: original two-pass BSAM from frozen source: Train-only inverse-sqrt 10 Mg/ha bin weights in ascent pass, rho=0.2, unweighted center-pixel MSE at perturbed weights in second pass, restore weights then one Adam update; BN running stats update only in first pass
validation: all 103550 official Validation rows after every epoch; eval mode and no gradients
checkpoint_selection: strictly lowest full Validation Overall RMSE across all completed epochs
execution: parallel six arms on one GPU; wall-clock times recorded but NOT compute-cost evidence (Review-12 serial-exclusive-GPU data remains the cost evidence)
test: not accessed for training, tuning or checkpoint selection; one official Test evaluation (119991 rows) only after all six arms report COMPLETE
primary_question: With S2 as the only sample-varying input information, does the paired BSAM-versus-Plain advantage persist, and how does S2-only compare to full-source within the same seed?
